matched_articles.title: LG Electronics India bets on exports, B2B products for margin boost
matched_articles.summary: LG Electronics 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'LG Electronics India bets on exports, B2B products for margin boost'이다. LG Electronics India is looking to exports and B2B products as key growth drivers as its Korean parent aims to make India a global manufacturing hub. The company expects these businesses to help improve margins amid pressure from higher raw material costs, rupee depreciation and geopolitical risks.
